title: Dragonfly Completes Its First Simulated Flight
paragraphs: Dragonfly is a NASA flying machine. It will go to Titan. Titan is a moon of Saturn.
This week, Dragonfly made its first test flight on a computer. The test was at a lab in Maryland. The machine was not in the air. The flight was only a simulation.
The computer test went well. Dragonfly will fly alone on Titan, so engineers must test everything first. It will go to space in 2028 or later.

questions.a: To Titan, a moon of Saturn.

questions.q: Was the test flight in the air?
questions.a: No, it was a computer simulation.
